subject: U-CHAIN r2 standards: NO-GO, 3 Required
body: Reviewed U-CHAIN round 2 at 0dbc669e, recorded blind expectations before the diff, and left only the authorized standards report uncommitted. Original standards fixes and line-wrap normalization are closed, but the verdict is NO-GO with three Required findings: stale remote resume refs, the missing mutant fixture, and a harness that returns success when controls fail. The validator and all 1,707 tests pass in a clean scratch checkout; the coordinator still needs these fixes and resolution of the documented BOT-3 residuals before a new SHA-bound review.
